---
title: "Bring the edition's inputs together"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
manual:
  page: 10
---

Start from the directory that contains the edition metadata and template. Do
not begin by editing the assembled post: the section files and their inputs are
the working source.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm the starting point"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -f params.yml
test -f template.qmd
test -f Newsletter_Preproc.qmd
test -e _data/newsletter/Newsletter_Content_Triage.csv
test -f _data/newsletter/articles.bib
test -f _data/newsletter/blogs.bib
test -f _data/newsletter/media.bib
```

The current directory should be the newsletter workspace, and the shared `_data`
path should resolve to the website repository's data directory.

:::

## Choose the working snapshot

::: {.manual-procedure title="Inspect the triage export"}

Look at the available exports before allowing the helper to consolidate them.
The newest file is normally the working one, but its contents still require
human review.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
ls -lt _data/newsletter/Newsletter_Content_Triage*.csv
sed -n '1,12p' _data/newsletter/Newsletter_Content_Triage.csv
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Confirm the edition metadata"}

Set the date, title, image, alt text, and section choices in `params.yml`.
Section files supply the writing; this file decides which pieces belong in the
edition.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
sed -n '1,80p' params.yml
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Inputs are ready to be transformed"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -s params.yml
test -s _data/newsletter/Newsletter_Content_Triage.csv
test -s _data/newsletter/articles.bib
```

:::
